svg.title: Comparing a cell width and a scale bar
svg.desc: Two proportional bars represent image readings of 48 pixels for a cell width and 122 pixels for the scale bar. The bar represents 20 micrometres. Forty-eight divided by 122 is about 0.39; 0.39 times 20 micrometres is about 8 micrometres. The pixel readings are from the source image, not this drawing.
